svg.aria-label: The top-level structure holds five instances: the floor points at the floor BLAS, at (0, 0, 0), and the red, white, green and light spheres all point at one sphere BLAS, at their own positions. The floor BLAS holds 2 triangles; the sphere BLAS holds 3,968, in boxes within boxes.
